question: What is the primary role of the Transformer self-attention mechanism?
expected_answer: It computes pairwise attention weights across all tokens in a sequence simultaneously, allowing the model to dynamically weight the relevance of every token regardless of distance.
source: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al., 2017) / Deep Learning Textbook

question: Why should API token usage and latency be tracked per call in LLM applications?
expected_answer: To monitor operational unit economics, detect latency spikes or regressions, enforce rate limits, prevent prompt injection runaway costs, and budget infrastructure scaling.
source: 12-Factor App & Production LLM Patterns / Experiment 3 & 5 Guide

question: How does Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) differ from WordPiece tokenization?
expected_answer: BPE merges the most frequent adjacent symbol pair based on raw frequency counts, whereas WordPiece selects the pair that maximizes the likelihood of the language model training data.
source: HuggingFace NLP Course & Sennrich et al. (2016)

question: What is the benefit of building a provider-agnostic LLM client interface?
expected_answer: It abstracts vendor-specific API implementations, enabling hot-swapping between hosted models (OpenAI, Gemini) and local weights (Ollama) without breaking business application code.

question: What mechanisms mitigate 429 Rate Limit errors and network timeouts when calling LLM endpoints?
expected_answer: Exponential backoff with jitter, client-side token bucket rate limiting, semantic caching, and fallback routing to secondary provider tiers.
source: OpenAI / Google Cloud Resilience Best Practices
